sloka: रुद्धां तु नगरीं श्रुत्वा जातक्रोधो निशाचरः ।विधानं द्विगुणं कृत्वा प्रासादं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। ६.४२.२ ।।।।
transliteration: ruddhāṁ tu nagarīṁ śrutvā jātakrodho niśācaraḥ ।vidhānaṁ dviguṇaṁ kṛtvā prāsādaṁ so 'dhyarohata ।। 6.42.2 ।।।।

translations.english: On knowing that Lanka is occupied, the night ranger Ravana, became very furious and doubled the forces of Lanka for the protection and went to the top of Lanka palace.
